content: Error Name: EEP_E_WRITE_FAILED Short Description: EEPROM write failed (HW) Long Description: The Eeprom module reports this error when EEPROM write job fails due to a hardware error. Fail EEPROM write job failed (see [SWS_Eep_00249]). Detection Criteria: Pass EEPROM write job finished successfully (see [SWS_Eep_00248]).
